scientific_integrity: The sharp coefficient is proved by exact Schur-factorization, strict moment log-convexity, and explicit degree-two witnesses. Supplementary rational checks do not substitute for the universal analytic argument. Literature searches do not prove uniqueness.
scientific_limitations: This is a sharp state-space transverse gap, not an optimal direct metric distance to the pair-of-functions extremizer set. It assumes entire functions, Hilbert norms, all radial moments finite and global exterior domination. The first public motivating source concerns the Gaussian and monotone weighted Hilbert Fock principle.
title: Sharp variance-controlled stability for radial Fock Korenblum domination
